title: Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans Line-Up: Covered Lines and Entry Requirements
content:
# Plan Line-Up: Covered Lines and Entry Requirements

Bridgewell sells Utility Line Protection Plans in six plans. Each plan names the line types it covers and the properties it can be held on.

## Lines covered and bundle status

| Plan | Line types covered | Bundle covering more than one line type | Septic line covered | Private well line covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | exterior water service line | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | exterior electrical service line | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | sewer lateral; septic line | No | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | interior supply line; interior drain line | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | exterior water service line; sewer lateral; septic line | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | exterior water service line; sewer lateral; septic line; exterior electrical service line; interior supply line; interior drain line; exterior gas service line | Yes | Yes | No |

- **Septic line covered** — whether the line from the house to the septic tank is covered.
- **Private well line covered** — whether the line from a private well to the house is covered. No current plan covers it.
- **Bundle** — whether the plan is a bundle covering more than one line type. Only the Water and Sewer Line Bundle and the Total Home Lines Plan are bundles.

## Entry requirements

| Plan | Property types that may enroll | Ownership requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | single-family home, townhome, duplex | the owner is responsible for the service line |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | single-family home, townhome, duplex | the owner is responsible for the service line |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | single-family home, townhome, duplex | the owner is responsible for the service line |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | single-family home, townhome, duplex, condominium | none stated |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | single-family home, townhome, duplex | the owner is responsible for the service line |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | single-family home, townhome, duplex | the owner is responsible for the service line |

## Points read from the tables

- A condominium may enroll only in the Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan; every other plan admits single-family homes, townhomes and duplexes only.
- The septic line is covered by exactly the three plans that list it: the Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan, the Water and Sewer Line Bundle and the Total Home Lines Plan.
- The exterior gas service line appears only in the Total Home Lines Plan.
